messages:
carol: Heads-up — FinApps POC is failing when they send full chat history. Getting a "payload_too_large" / truncation and it's breaking evaluation. Can someone swarm? Logs below and model they're using: redwood-4o (8k).

samir: On it. Can you paste the raw error JSON + request_id and an example of the messages array (sanitized)? Also how many tokens approx are they sending?

carol: Error snippet from their app:
```
{
  "error": "payload_too_large",
  "message": "request size 18234 tokens exceeds model limit 8192",
  "request_id": "req_01G7Y2XQ9"
}
```
They say ~18k tokens when including ~250 chat turns (mostly short messages) + system prompt. They tried setting max_output_tokens but input is still trimmed and results are wrong.

maya: That aligns with a context window overflow. Two immediate paths:
1) Swap to a longer-context model (e.g., redwood-4o-32k or our extended-32k variant) — fastest fix but cost/latency impact.
2) Reduce payload: summarize older turns / store long history in an embeddings DB and only send the last N turns + retrieved relevant snippets.

Also note the runtime returns a clear error when total tokens exceed model limit; it will not silently accept — you'll see payload_too_large / 413-like behavior. We can also enable streaming for outputs but that doesn't help input size.

alex: Customer will push back on upgrading to 32k due to cost. Quick back-of-envelope: 32k context ~ 3x tokens billed compared to 8k (approx), depends on how much of that window they actually use. Recommend offering a trade-off doc and two POC options: 1) short-term: implement aggressive trimming + summarization (lower cost), 2) demonstration: switch to 32k for one week of tests (we can provide a time-limited promo credit).

samir: For troubleshooting, please try these reproducible steps and paste results: 
1) Minimal repro curl (sanitized) with X-Request-ID.
2) Add header `Redwood-Debug: true` to capture runtime diagnostics.
3) Try sending the payload to a longer-context staging model (redwood-4o-32k) to confirm behavior.

Example curl repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-1745532100' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4o","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."}, {"role":"user","content":"<...long history here...>"}], "max_output_tokens":512}'
```
If you get the payload_too_large error with that repro, attach the request-id and I can look up the server-side logs.

carol: I pushed the repro they used to a sanitized gist and shared with you (samir). Also customer asked if we can change server-side truncate behavior instead of rejecting.

maya: We can't silently auto-truncate input without changing semantics — that risks dropping critical context and causing hallucinations. Options: 
- Controlled truncate: return an explicit warning plus the truncated token counts (we can add that to error payload).
- Auto-summarize: run a pre-summarization step (small model or policy) to compress old history into a single summary token sequence.

alex: On pricing/contract: if they upgrade to a 32k model under Dedicated, we can offer a temporary trial of dedicated capacity for the POC or a one-time discount to offset token costs. I'm drafting a short email to present options.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFR-3219 for temporary token-limit bump request (linked to req_01G7Y2XQ9). Owner: @maya. ETA: 24h to review.

samir: Action plan: 
- Carol: get minimal repro + X-Request-ID (you said you did, thanks).
- Maya: check if we can return a more descriptive error (include token counts) and review INFR-3219.
- Alex: send cost comparison + trial offer.
- I'll attempt local repro against redwood-4o-32k and post results here.

customer-engineer: Thanks — repro posted. We'll try the 32k staging target now and report back.

samir: Quick note after local test: sending the exact payload to redwood-4o hit the 8192 limit and returned the same error. Sent to redwood-4o-32k in staging — it accepted the payload but response time increased ~1.6x and token usage reported ~18.7k input tokens + 420 output. Sharing logs and estimated cost delta in DM.

carol: Great — customer ok to test 32k for 48h if we can provide trial credits. Alex please advise. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll escalate with finance/ops and try to get a short promo applied. Will update in this thread by EOD.

maya: I'll add a follow-up ticket to improve error payloads to show `input_tokens` and `model_limit` so customers can programmatically detect this and fall back to summarization.

carol: Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me if you need the customer's CLA for a temp Dedicated test.
